paper_title: Improved Performance of All-Polymer Solar Cells Enabled by Naphthodiperylenetetraimide-Based Polymer Acceptor
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2017 - Guo - Improved Performance of All‐Polymer Solar Cells Enabled by/auto/Advanced Materials - 2017 - Guo - Improved Performance of All‐Polymer Solar Cells Enabled by.md

knowledge_points.content: NDP-V is a polymer acceptor featuring a backbone of alternating naphthodiperylenetetraimide (NDP) and vinylene units, designed to reduce conformational disorder by covalently fusing vinylene linkers to the bay regions of adjacent perylenediimide (PDI) units.
knowledge_points.evidence: By covalently fusing half of the vinylene linkers in PDI-V backbone to the bay region of adjacent PDI units on both sides, larger, shape-persistent NDP units are obtained, based on which a new polymer (NDP-V) featuring a poly(NDP-vinylene) backbone is designed and synthesized

knowledge_points.content: The all-polymer solar cell based on the PTB7-Th:NDP-V blend achieved a record-high power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 8.59% with an average value of 8.48%.
knowledge_points.evidence: With this polymer acceptor, a new record power-conversion efficiencies (PCE) of 8.59% has been achieved for all-PSCs... an average PCE of 8.48% is obtained

knowledge_points.content: The PTB7-Th:NDP-V device exhibits a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 17.07 mA cm⁻², an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.74 V, and a fill factor (FF) of 0.67.
knowledge_points.evidence: All these factors contribute to a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 17.07 mA cm-2... a Voc of 0.74 V... With a fill factor (FF) of 0.67

knowledge_points.content: NDP-V possesses a LUMO level of -4.03 eV and a HOMO level of -5.94 eV; the HOMO is lowered by 0.17 eV compared to PDI-V due to the reduced density of vinylene donor units in the main chain.
knowledge_points.evidence: NDP-V possesses a lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) of about -4.03 eV... the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) of NDP-V is lowered by more than 0.1 eV relative to that of PDI-V... The partially locked backbone of NDP-V reduced the density of vinylene donor units in the main chain, which originated the lower lying HOMO

knowledge_points.content: The electron mobility of neat NDP-V film measured by the space-charge limited current (SCLC) method is 2.5 x 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, which is higher than that of PDI-V (1.9 x 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹).
knowledge_points.evidence: the electron mobility of NDP-V is calculated to be about 2.5 x 10-3 cm2 V-1 s-1, which is evidently higher than that of PDI-V.

knowledge_points.content: The PTB7-Th:NDP-V blend shows more balanced charge transport than PTB7-Th:PDI-V, with a hole-to-electron mobility ratio (μh/μe) of 3.3 compared to 3.8.
knowledge_points.evidence: The smaller μh/μe value of the former is also beneficial for improving FF of the solar cell. (Table 2: NDP-V μh/μe = 3.3, PDI-V μh/μe = 3.8)

knowledge_points.content: High-performance NDP-V based all-PSCs are fabricated using chlorobenzene (CB) as the solvent without the need for solvent additives or post-treatments like thermal annealing.
knowledge_points.evidence: No solvent additive or post-treatment of the cells is required for achieving such high performance (Table S1, Supporting Information).

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS characterization of the PTB7-Th:NDP-V blend film indicates a preferential face-on orientation, with (100) peaks observed in the in-plane (IP) direction and (010) peaks in the out-of-plane (OOP) direction.
knowledge_points.evidence: The (100) and (010) peaks are observable preferentially in IP and OOP directions, respectively, indicating preferential face-on orientation is exhibited

knowledge_points.content: NDP-V exhibits an optical bandgap of 1.91 eV and shows enhanced absorption at 402 nm and 547 nm compared to PDI-V, providing a better spectral complement to the donor PTB7-Th.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optical bandgap of NDP-V is slightly widened compared to that of PDI-V... The extinction coefficients of the absorption peaks at 400 and 545 nm... are both substantially increased

knowledge_points.content: The performance of NDP-V based all-PSCs is relatively insensitive to the length of the alkyl side chains (ranging from 1-pentylhexyl to 1-octylnonyl), which is attributed to the large, shape-persistent NDP backbone dominating the material morphology.
knowledge_points.evidence: When the side chain length is extended from 1-pentylhexyl to 1-octylnonyl, the solar cell performance exhibits only insignificant fluctuations... the relatively insensitive dependence of the polymer acceptor performance on the side-chain length is likely related to the unique geometry of NDP structure.

knowledge_points.content: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) reveals that the PTB7-Th:NDP-V blend forms a smooth surface with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 0.86 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: The height and phase images reveal that the PTB7-Th:NDP-V blend forms relatively smooth and uniform surface with a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of 0.86 nm

knowledge_points.content: The optimized device uses an inverted structure consisting of ITO/ZnO/PTB7-Th:NDP-V/V2O5/Al with an active layer thickness of approximately 120 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: using the inverted device configuration of ITO/ZnO/PTB7-Th:NDP-V/V2O5/Al... obtain a thickness of ≈120 nm
